notes.title: The Deepwatch - Update 19.03.2025
notes.notes:
[h1]Version - XXXX[/h1]

[b]Developer's note:[/b] This patch is aimed at enhancing the gaming experience and addressing several issues encountered by players.
[h2]PC[/h2]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed the functionality of elements on the "desk."

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
- Visual design of the "Dialog" element has been updated;
- The display of information about committed violations has been modified;
- Training has been improved, and an "Instructions" section has been added.
